import bz2
import os
import tomllib
from pathlib import Path

def new_compressor():
    profiles = tomllib.loads(Path("config/compression.toml").read_text())
    active = profiles[os.environ["ARCHIVE_PROFILE"]]
    return bz2.BZ2Compressor(active["compresslevel"])
files.tests/check_config.py:
from pathlib import Path
import re
import tomllib

text = Path('config/compression.toml').read_bytes().decode('utf-8').replace('\r\n', '\n')
assert re.fullmatch('\\[cold_store\\]\\ncompresslevel = [^\\s#]+\\nchunk_bytes = 32768\\n\\n\\[live_feed\\]\\ncompresslevel = 3\\nchunk_bytes = 8192\\n?', text), 'Only the requested value tokens may change'
cfg = tomllib.loads(text)
v = cfg['cold_store']['compresslevel']
assert type(v) is int and v == 9
import bz2
compressor = bz2.BZ2Compressor(v)
assert bz2.decompress(compressor.compress(b'catalog') + compressor.flush()) == b'catalog'
